description_en: One rattan and bamboo household product. Front: A long flexible woven strip ends in two broad straight bound borders. Side: Its thin layered profile rests flat with a slight natural curvature. Rear: The reverse face exposes the continuous interlacing and tied border ends. Smooth bound joints, visibly interlaced natural fibers, empty clean inserts where specified. No writing, numbers, logos, marks, labels or other objects.
prompt: Use case: product-mockup. Create ONE photorealistic Vietnamese rattan/bamboo studio catalog product. One genuinely flexible long narrow rectangular woven TABLE RUNNER lying FLAT HORIZONTALLY on the studio surface. Its long axis runs left-to-right across the image. Thin textile-like rattan/bamboo strips form the continuous mat, with only slender bound edge strips and two flat straight end borders. No rigid tubular perimeter, no corner posts, no legs, no raised walls, no solid panel frame. Slight natural waviness is allowed, but not an upright fence or screen. Style Sang trọng: refined precise proportions and minimal plain hardware. Relative size generous within its class. Woven surface: plain over-one-under-one basket weave. Finish: deep walnut-brown dye with visible fiber grain. Canonical FRONT camera azimuth zero, centered straight in front of the long/broad front edge, with a modest downward elevation so the top woven surface is visible. Preserve the natural horizontal resting orientation. Whole product, generous margins, no measurements, no props, no text anywhere. Whole object visible, centered with generous margins. Plain warm-white seamless studio backdrop, soft lighting and subtle shadow, sharp fiber texture. Square image. No props, room, people, animals, food, plants, detached extra products, collage, diagram or border. ABSOLUTELY NO TEXT ANYWHERE: no letters, numbers, words, symbols, labels, logos, captions, watermarks, measurements or inscriptions.
